description: gryphon_playground CI record (req-boot-bootstrap-ci-record) — the stack this plugin's own tests run in, and the one claim per-plugin CI is allowed to make: that gryphon_playground is correct against the dependencies it DECLARES and nothing else. Install set is exactly the depends_on closure (grid_fixtures, whose grid_fixtures__* node/edge vocabulary the Gridkin corpus references by string) plus gryphon_playground itself; the consumer — the plugin-ci boot-and-test lane, or `spawn --dev-plugins gryphon_playground` locally — flips the self entry to editable so the CHECKOUT under test is what runs, not the released tag. DELIBERATELY EXCLUDED: every other plugin (the corpus asserted table sets that only existed on a stack carrying compliance_core until 2026-08-27; the oracles now derive their roster from the live registry, and this record is what keeps them honest), all credentials, all required_secrets, and any population step that reaches the network — so a fork can run this lane and a nightly cannot flake on a third party. The Gridkin corpus builds its scenarios at query time, hence an empty population section. Reproduce CI exactly: spawn --from 'git+https://github.com/unified-systems-com/tap-plugin-gryphon-playground@v0.3.3#ci' --dev-plugins gryphon_playground

plugins.note: The one declared dependency (tap-plugin.toml depends_on). Install-only: the neutral grid_fixtures__* node/edge vocabulary the corpus queries by string, migrated so the scenarios have real types. Public repo, so no `credential` (req-tap-plugin-arch-source-secret-5).

Self, pinned like any app-of-apps record (req-boot-bootstrap-stage0-3) — the CONSUMER substitutes the checkout under test via tap.dev_workspace, so no CI directory layout is baked in here (req-boot-bootstrap-ci-record-4). Booting this record unflipped is a coherent stack: it runs the released tag.
